hook.text: Flynn Restaurant Group owns 2,400 restaurants across 6 brands. One franchisee, $4 billion in sales.

buildup.text: Multi-unit franchisees operate dozens or hundreds of locations, creating economies of scale within the system.

discovery.text: They share managers, negotiate supplier deals, and spread overhead across many units.

twist.text: Multi-unit operators have leverage over franchisors. Losing a 100-store operator is a major revenue event.

climax.text: 75% of new franchise locations go to existing multi-unit operators, not first-time buyers.

punchline.text: 2,400 restaurants, one owner. Franchising consolidation is accelerating.

quiz.question: What percentage of new franchise locations go to multi-unit operators?
